name: Vanderpump Villa
description: Follows the hand-picked crew of Lisa Vanderpump's opulent French villa as they live and cooperate to satisfy each extravagant want of their affluent visitors.

videos.title: Welcome to Chateau Rosabelle
videos.overview: For months, Lisa Vanderpump has meticulously curated her latest business venture: a chateau in the South of France. But when the first guests check in for a luxury experience, will the new staff be able to provide the service that meets Lisa’s standards?

videos.title: No Room for Error
videos.overview: Upon learning of a huge argument in front of the guests, Lisa sets her staff straight. With the marquee event less than 24 hours away, can the staff put aside their differences and come together to help the Guest of Honor pull off a secret proposal?

videos.title: From One Queen to Another
videos.overview: The Chateau welcomes a close circle of friends who are celebrating a ‘Rebirth’ party. Eric attempts to navigate managing duties while receiving pushback from Stephen and Lisa. Two ladies in the staff develop romantic feelings for the same co-worker.

videos.title: A Naughty Night in Versailles
videos.overview: One staff member’s antics reach a new high, causing a rift in the back of the house. But when a new group of guests arrive with their own set of issues, lines become blurred, and the drama spills over to the front of the house.

videos.title: Revenge of Les Dames
videos.overview: When a group of eligible bachelors arrive for a stay in the Chateau, the ladies in the staff could not be more thrilled to make the male staff a little jealous. Marciano finds himself in hot water with just about everyone after a night of debauchery.

videos.title: An Unforgettable Night in Carcassonne
videos.overview: While things heat up romantically between two staff members, another employee begins to isolate themselves. But when sparks fly at a festive dinner in town, ugly truths are revealed, making everyone question their relationships in the chateau.

videos.title: A Divorce Party
videos.overview: After an explosive dinner in town, lines are crossed, and one staff member questions their future at the chateau. When a new group of guests shows up to celebrate their divorce, old memories resurface, sending another staff member into a downward spiral.

videos.title: Love, Death, and Beyond
videos.overview: The Chateau welcomes a guest of honor who wants to celebrate her 30’s and say goodbye to her tumultuous 20’s by having a funeral service. Meanwhile, Hannah tries to navigate some of her own past insecurities with relationships, and Marciano.

videos.title: Reunited and It Feels So Good
videos.overview: A recent staff member’s arrival continues to ruffle some feathers, while another employee sees an opportunity for the taking. When a seasoned group of guests shows up to the villa, they breathe new life into the Chateau.

videos.title: Bon Voyage, Bollywood Style
videos.overview: The final guests of the season celebrate an extravagant bridal shower, but tempers flare when one team member reveals they are “over it.” Later, Lisa plans several surprises for the staff before they depart, and new relationships are tested.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Hosted by Karamo, Lisa Vanderpump reunites her staff to relive Chateau Rosabelle’s most unforgettable moments and give her final comment card. As shocking new developments come to light, Lisa shares an unexpected bombshell that leaves everyone reeling.

videos.title: New Staff, New Secrets... New Stassi
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump is back and once again curating bespoke experiences for eager guests. This time around an Italian castle is the backdrop, Stassi Schroeder returns, and there is a mix of familiar and new staff, ready to impress.

videos.title: Gold Medal Drama
videos.overview: A group of reality stars and global athletes arrive at the castle for some rest and relaxation. One staff member would rather play than work, which causes tension among the staff, and love is in the air for some couples, but toxicity is real for others.

videos.title: Momtoks and Mormons, Oh My!
videos.overview: A night of arguing leaves some staff wary of Siadi and Sianna's relationship. `The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' arrive at the Castle, Sam and Marciano are especially intrigued, but an innocent drinking game ends in hurt feelings and deception.

videos.title: Fireworks and Falling Apart
videos.overview: Andre has a change of heart about his relationship with Gabriella and seeks Lisa's advice. The staff enjoys a night out at a lake, but when one couple decides to intervene in another's argument, fireworks fly in the sky and through the castle.

videos.title: Castello Catastrophe
videos.overview: Marciano and Hannah find themselves in hot water with Lisa for their recent actions. Grace decides to act on her crush, and when a new group of beautiful women arrive at the castle, Tyler finds himself in the doghouse with Lexee.

videos.title: Brewing and Boiling Over
videos.overview: A botched breakfast service upsets Chef Anthony, Sam finds potential romance and Dominic turns his attention to another Staffer, much to Graces' dismay. A meltdown in Lisa's office empowers Sianna to make a decision about her future with Siadi.

videos.title: Stassi's Birthday Meltdown
videos.overview: Lisa plans for a birthday party planned at the castle and the front of the house clashes with the back of the house after an imperfect dinner service. An argument over a tattoo sends Beau and Stassi spiraling during a family visit.

videos.title: The Haunted Castle
videos.overview: Some new faces in the castle shake up the old dynamic within the staff quarters and a budding romance blossoms. Sam and Siadi reach a breaking point with each other and when a group of guests ghost hunt in the castle, Stassi is ready to oblige.

videos.title: Who Is This Guy?
videos.overview: Siadi's lack of emotion rubs most of the staff the wrong way, leading to a major group confrontation. Stassi and Beau decide to cook everyone a decadent thank you meal; and tensions within the kitchen staff boil over in the last days at the castle.

videos.title: A Surprising Twist
videos.overview: The final group of guests celebrate a surprise engagement party, but one of the staff members makes them extremely uncomfortable and Lisa is enraged. As the summer season comes to the end, the most exemplary employee is recognized.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: After an Italian summer of high stakes, scandal, and celebration at Castello Rosato, Lisa Vanderpump reunites her staff for one final night of reckoning—only this time, she’s handing the hosting reins to her VIP guest, the one and only Stassi Schroeder.

videos.title: The Butler Did It
videos.overview: Lisa Vanderpump returns to England for the summer, taking over Rosecroft Park, a sprawling countryside estate. As familiar faces reunite, returning staff waste no time revealing the drama that has followed them since Italy. Marciano and Hannah are.

videos.title: Delulu is the Solulu
videos.overview: Reality star Ekin-Su Cülcüloğlu arrives with her Love Island crew, and male staffers quickly compete for her attention, sparking tension between guest groups. Meanwhile, Tyler grows close to housekeeper Sage, leading to a steamy hot tub moment.

videos.title: Horniest Boat Ride Ever
videos.overview: A game of Never Have I Ever reignites the feud between Gabriella and Merredith, with Keviah soon pulled into the conflict; the two departing guest groups make their feelings about each other clear.

videos.title: Up for the Challenge
videos.overview: "The Challenge" guests continue pushing limits at the Villa and one reckless night leaves serious damage, putting Lisa Vanderpump on edge; when she hears guest Devin refuse to apologize to Charlie, Lisa issues an ultimatum.

videos.title: Rosecroft at War
videos.overview: Meredith comforts Alyssa, who suddenly seems unsure where things stand with Dominic, while Marciano grows uneasy about the upcoming surprise guests. Hannah and Marciano question Nick about his background, and the tense exchange escalates.

videos.title: Most Dramatic Rose(croft) Ceremony Ever
videos.overview: Gabriella and Sher try to help Hannah sort through her relationship, but their advice only heightens the tension; flirtations between "The Bachelor" guests and staff deepen; Tyler and Sage's relationship swings between highs and lows.

videos.title: Crossing Jordan
videos.overview: The staff is stunned to learn the next guests are DadTok from "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives," including Jordan, whose wife was at the center of Marciano's recent scandal; as their arrival approaches, Marciano scrambles to find allies.

videos.title: The Secret Lives of #DadTok
videos.overview: Lisa and Stassi try to untangle the latest revelations around the Mormon Wives, pushing Stassi to confront Jordan directly; at lunch, members of DadTok share blunt opinions about the Mormon Wives; a feud between Chef Anthony and Gabriella escalates.

videos.title: Kitchen Nightmares
videos.overview: Lisa finally loses patience with Hannah and Marciano, leading to an emotional confrontation; Chef Anthony also raises concerns about another staff member, making Lisa realize the team may be more divided than she thought.

videos.title: Rocking the Boat
videos.overview: As summer ends, sparks fly between Alyssa and Nick, setting off gossip across the staff; the final event features a performance from the guests of "RuPaul's Drag Race" and the staff embrace the fun.
